messages:
alex: Midweek goalie dilemma — Burnley away, heavy rain forecast. Fantasy playoffs tomorrow. Keep Pickford (has CS history) or switch to Ramsdale for Arsenal run? Also who’s up for The Local after QA? :beer:

maria: I'd bench Pickford. Burnley attack looks sharp. Ramsdale safer for the short term. also yes to The Local :raised_hands:

devon: Quick poll: start Ramsdale ✅ or trust form? (vote with emoji)

sasha: Ramsdale :thumbsup:

jamie: Pickford :thumbsdown: leaning Ramsdale. got a partial lineup change:
```
GK: Ramsdale
DEF: Cancelo, Dias
MID: Odegaard, Mount
FWD: Hojlund
```

fantasy-bot: Reminder: Trade deadline in 48 hours — you have 1 pending offers. https://fantasy.league/tx/12345

taylor: If we're meeting after, I can grab a table at 7:30. who needs wings vs. salads? :pizza: :green_salad:

alex: tally — Ramsdale: :thumbsup:, Pickford: :thumbsdown:. Ramsdale wins. Table at 7:30 at The Local. wings for me. anyone want to put together a last-minute waiver for D Coady? quick pick.

maria: can we do 2 orders wings + 1 vegan? :100:

devon: yes on waivers for Coady if price under 5%. I can set it to auto.

sasha: @alex thanks for organizing. see y'all later. :wave:

fantasy-bot: Waiver processed for taylor — Coady added to bench. Good luck!
